notes: checkpoints are gitignored local weights; their sha256 and worktree-relative path are recorded so ticket #9 can verify whichever copy it scores
the warm-start checkpoint identity (sha256 + config digest + load provenance) is recorded per seed in `warmstart` and per candidate in `candidates`
capped = consumed the 100-epoch budget without early stopping; not a failure
all 45 candidates and their validation curves are recorded; no seed is dropped

recipe.note: resolved from the frozen locked config; no CLI budget override was passed

selection_rule.incomplete_policy: a fold with fewer than three complete seeds at an LR is not eligible; a fold with no complete LR is recorded as incomplete and the record gate fails
selection_rule.rule: per fold, choose the LR maximising the mean over the three seeds of the best validation direction AUPRC@200 (k=200)
selection_rule.test_usage: never for training, LR, epoch, checkpoint or seed selection
selection_rule.tie_break: lower LR, then ascending-LR candidate order

checks: same folds, seeds, learning rates, recipe, budget and selection rule; only the initialisation differs

assertions: every queue unit runs `train.py --stage finetune`; run_queue.py launches nothing else
no run directory holds a prediction/ or evaluation/ tree (ALLOWED_RUN_ENTRIES)
the ticket-#4 CMDataset loads only the fold's train/valid roles; test rows are forbidden rows and the 20-test leakage suite covers this
selection uses only the validation AUPRC curve recorded in fit_history.json
test scored once, after selection, by ticket #9 — not by this substep

title: 45 Tahoe-init CM candidates (5 folds x 3 seeds x 3 LRs) and per-fold LR selection

anti_random_init.canary: fresh random_init(model, seed) with the same structure and seed

warmstart.failure_policy: any missing/wrong-axis/wrong-seed/partially-loading checkpoint raises before the queue is written; a run whose manifest init proof differs from this block is marked failed
